query: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.thumbnailUrl, p.backImageUrl, pv.id as variantId, pv.name as variantName, pv.retailPrice, pv.size, pv.color, pv.imageUrl, pv.printfulVariantId, pv.printfulSyncVariantId FROM products p JOIN productVariants pv ON pv.productId = p.id WHERE p.name LIKE '%Flag Bearer%' ORDER BY p.id, pv.size;
